verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a local-first, offline-first model: all content is stored locally in a Vault you own, the app works without an internet connection, and a local-only mode disables the backup node entirely. Its Markdown export lets you get notes out into readable files. However, the native store is an encrypted container meant to be read through the app (or its localhost API/CLI), not plain files, so reading your notes without the app depends on exporting them. Missing for 10: notes stored as directly readable plain files without export, independent hands-on corroboration of fully offline operation.
